inputs.goal: list the spring hardware line on Amazon under its claims policy

write.listing_copy: Spring Hardware Line - Premium quality springs for various applications including automotive, industrial, and residential use. Features include durable materials, precise manufacturing tolerances, and comprehensive performance specifications. All products meet or exceed industry standards for safety and reliability. Commercial applications subject to additional compliance requirements. For specific claims about load capacity, material composition, or performance metrics, please reference the detailed product specification sheets available on each item's Amazon product page.
